entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Properly annotate dotnet CLI MSBuild-OM build call sites for trimming (IL2026) #55225
  • `NuGet` Download step in CI introduces flakiness #55224
  • .NET SDK 10.0.1xx design-time builds of net8.0-targeted projects resolve zero framework references (silent skeleton compilations under MSBuildWorkspace) #55217
  • Microsoft.Testing.Platform test host crash on shutdown: "Failed to flush logs before the timeout of '300' seconds" (FileLogger.Dispose) #55215
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers v10.0.301: CA30xx interprocedural analysis causes infinite build / StackOverflow on .NET Framework 4.8 projects #55214

Closed

  • Can't update vulnerable packages #54798
  • `dotnetup` should be able to recover when a release does not have archives #54627
  • `dotnetup` fails with "Error: Sequence contains no elements" after successful `dotnetup init ~ Terminal Mode/Isolation Mode` #54840
  • `get-dotnetup` scripts should be on versioned urls #54990
  • get-dotnetup.ps is unsigned #54777
  • get-dotnetup.ps1: intermittent 'OSArchitecture' PropertyNotFoundException under strict mode #54683
  • .NET bootstrapper for improving SDK acquisition and update #50623
  • Sign .NET archives and release manifests to support DNUP #51104
  • .NET 10 dotnet pack chokes on output folder named dotnet #54953
  • `dotnetup`: Add `paths` Install Logic Test with Global.Json #50606
  • [NETSDKE2E] Maui workload install failed with SDK .NET 10.0.300 arm64 Binaries. #54141
  • Could Not Resolve SDK - repo testfx issue #51530

PullRequests

Created

  • Update VersionFeature80 and VersionFeature90 calculations for the August release #55222
  • Forward Azure DevOps log commands and host display messages to dotnet test (protocol 1.2.0/1.3.0) #55221
  • [release/8.0.1xx] Disable network isolation on internal PR builds; enforce CFSClean3 on official #55220
    Servicing-consider
  • Work around license scan timeout by scanning source-build-assets serially #55219
    Servicing-consider
  • Consolidate generated-file guardrails in agent instructions #55218
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.3.0-preview.26325.12 to 4.3.0 #55213
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Reliable CLI telemetry via a persist-then-drain OpenTelemetry exporter #55211

Merged

  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview6] Fix dnx dispatcher to resolve install dir through symlinks #55223
    backport, 11.0-preview6
  • Preserve dotnetup output and return only the exit code from Invoke-DotnetupNativeCommand #55208
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Use full Application Insights connection string instead of instrumentation key #55178
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.11
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Use full Application Insights connection string instead of instrumentation key #55177
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.11
  • Bump OpenTelemetry pins to match SBRP (core/Http 1.16.0, Runtime 1.15.1) #55216
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #55169
  • Add add-cli-command skill for dotnet CLI command/option changes #55199
  • `dotnetup`: Add support for Fish shell #55192

Updated

  • Dotnetup: add `env` command to update PathPreference mode #54545
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55161
    Area-Roslyn
  • [watch] Static web asset abstraction #55188
  • Improve `dotnetup` error handling #55155
  • Conditional test filtering framework for PR builds #55166
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55175
  • Enable NativeAOT CLI command handling by default (DOTNET_CLI_ENABLEAOT) #55144
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, 11.0.1xx
  • Add location-gated AGENTS.md guidance for key src and test subtrees #55198
  • Fix composite ReadyToRun publish when RelativePath has a path component #55200
    Area-ReadyToRun
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #55146
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #55207
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #55158
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55202
  • Do not bundle the ILCompiler (NativeAOT) on ppc64le #55051
